# Getting help

- For reproducible bugs, [open a bug report](https://github.com/boredpolymath/Gridshift/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml).
- For product ideas, [open a feature request](https://github.com/boredpolymath/Gridshift/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml).
- Before opening an issue, check existing issues and review the [README](../README.md) for setup and product guidance.
- Never include private utility records, credentials, or personal data in a public issue.
- For security vulnerabilities, follow the private process in [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).
